spec_match.rationale: Runs the exact shipped surface — repeated startRendering(chunkSize) on a finite OfflineAudioContext — and demonstrates the three normative fingerprints (per-call buffers, quantum alignment, final-chunk trim), detected behaviorally from returned buffer lengths rather than wishful feature checks.

interactive.rationale: A run button executes the real chunk loop over a real oscillator graph, filling the call table and painting the waveform chunk by chunk.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the loop, rounding, trimming and the behavioral probe; the page delivers each, including the one-shot detection row.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles the pre-158 one-shot (argument ignored) with a labelled legacy verdict, caps the loop defensively, and shows exceptions verbatim.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5109900936085504 and the spec's startRendering section; the feature index carries the explainer and sample page.

conformance.rationale: New 6-assertion feature suite mirrors these contracts (optional length, chunk return, quantum rounding, trim, zero-chunk error, exhausted error) with the async runner awaiting each; on this container's Chromium 141 the behavioral assertions read honest fails.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 with --enable-blink-features=OfflineAudioContextIncrementalRendering (name unknown to that build, so a no-op) via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): run clicked, first call returned all 8000 frames, the one-shot verdict and explanation displayed, waveform canvas verified painted, zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow, desktop screenshot read. Partial: the chunked path needs a 158+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Branch-specific asserts (chunks-sum-to-length / final-chunk-trimmed on the chunked path, legacy-one-shot-detected on the legacy path); no unhandled rejections.

design_system.rationale: Table and verdict colors are design-system variables on light surfaces at AA; the trimmed-cell highlight also carries the word 'trimmed'.

accessibility.rationale: Native button, caption + scoped-header table, canvas carries role=img with a descriptive label and all information it shows is duplicated in the table, verdict is aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read.

summary: The chunk loop over a real oscillator graph with behavioral support detection, quantum/trim fingerprints and a per-chunk waveform. Driven on headless Chromium 141 (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): honest one-shot legacy verdict, painted canvas, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
